messages:
Iris: opened a PR to clarify SOC2/audit-export wording + add .NET SDK snippet and a short note about jurisdictional retention differences. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1203
Diego: nice. legal asked we avoid exact deletion promises. suggested phrasing: 'retained consistent with our documented retention policy and applicable law (including jurisdictional requirements).'
Marta: engineering request: we should ensure examples don't use real-looking API keys or tenant ids. use placeholders and call out 'do not paste production keys in public examples'.
Iris: good catch — i'll replace all tokens with placeholders and add a quick warning in the snippet area.
Diego: legal also wants a short sentence about retention exceptions: 'certain records may be preserved under legal hold or regulatory obligation.' keep it high-level.
Marta: adding .NET example (compact):
```csharp
// .NET SDK (new)
using Redwood.Client;
var client = new RedwoodClient(env: Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("REDWOOD_API_KEY"));
var resp = await client.Audit.ExportAsync(new AuditExportRequest { TenantId = "{{TENANT_ID}}", RetentionPolicy = "audit:180d", Redaction = true });
Console.WriteLine(resp.Url);
```

Legacy note: older .NET clients used RetentionDays (int). we'll include a tiny migration snippet showing the rename.
Iris: i'll add a quick localization note: retention timelines in examples are illustrative; customers should consult local law and their contract for exact obligations. also adding SOC2 FAQ cross-ref.
Diego: legal ok with that. tiny editorial: change 'redaction = true' -> 'redaction_applied = true' in public docs copy for clarity.
Marta: updated snippet. also added a troubleshooting bullet: if export link 401/403, check service key scopes and tenant export permissions. added CI checklist item to run the .NET snippet in the SDK smoke tests.
Iris: replaced sample ids with placeholders and added the 'do not paste production credentials' warning. removed any internal infra mentions per legal.
docs-bot: Preview deployed: https://docs.redwood.ai/previews/1203/audit-export-dotnet-clarity preview expires in 7 days. :sparkles:
Diego: quick +1 pending final legal sign-off. will do a short pass tomorrow.
Iris: thanks all planning to merge after legal signs off and the snippet passes CI.
